column1: # The store's edge blocks (spec v14 V4), written by test/oracle.jl's own writer (answer_lines): each case a line
# `case <name> <verdict>` and its records, read alone by both readers of answer records, test/oracle_read.jl's
# read_answers (test/src/oracle_read.jl) and dev/climb/measure.py's unit_blocks (climb.py door-probe's reader
# rows), which must give label e/a the case's verdict: whole (its answer, or its noanswer, read), dropped (not
# whole: no answer read) or refused (named twice). The case `cut` ends with no newline (an append cut short).
